**Texere 0.4.17** · 13 November 2026

- **Citing from Zotero:** if you close the "Reference only / Reference and PDF" choice (Esc or a click elsewhere), nothing is added and your text goes back to what you typed.

Also in this version (from 0.4.16, 0.4.15): choose whether a Zotero reference comes with its PDF and annotations; the pointer in PDFs selects without copying into the note; faster highlights; @ citations from Zotero without Better BibTeX; the bibliography right after the text.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
